Tests that Emulation.setTimezoneOverride works when sent to a service worker target.

Set timezone to Asia/Shanghai in service worker
Detected service worker timezone: Asia/Shanghai

Overwrite timezone with Europe/Paris in service worker
Detected service worker timezone: Europe/Paris

Reset timezone to default in service worker
Timezone correctly reset to initial value: true
